= GitHub Actions

This file describes the workflows in `.github/workflows/` as they run today.
It does not change them.
A Claude mention is the maintainer text that asks Claude to run.
These workflows do not request a Codex review.

Every job uses `ubuntu-latest`.
Continuous Integration uses Node `22.x`, `24.x`, and `26.x`.
Other jobs that install dependencies use Node `26.x`.
Claude jobs need `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` and commit through the GitHub API.
Publish authenticates to npm with GitHub OIDC.

== Overview

Pull requests, and pushes to `main` or `vX.Y.x`, run Continuous Integration.

Renovate opens one pull request per dependency.
Dependency Review may push one follow-up commit.
Codex then reviews that pull request, and any pull request Claude opened for an issue.
Codex Review asks Claude to fix open findings for two rounds, then only reports them.
The watchdog flags a loop pull request that has had no Codex review for two hours.

A Claude mention, or the `claude` label, runs Claude on anything that is not a release.
On an issue, Claude opens `claude-issue-<number>-...` and a pull request ready for review.

A release is an open issue titled `Release @perfective/build vX.Y.Z`.
The `claude` label runs Publish PR instead.
Claude opens `Publish vX.Y.Z` from `publish-vX.Y.Z`.
The maintainer squash-merges, signs the tag, and pushes it.
Publish runs `npm publish` from that tag.
The maintainer creates the GitHub Release. The workflow does not.

== ci.yaml

Continuous Integration.
Push to `main` and `vX.Y.x`, and every pull request.
`npm ci`, `npm run lint:build`, `npm run dist` on each Node version above.
No tests.

== dependency-review.yaml

Dependency Review.
A Renovate pull request, when Renovate opens, reopens, or updates it,
or when a maintainer adds `claude-review`.
Claude runs the `update-dependency` skill and may push one signed follow-up.
A successful run starts Codex Review again.

== claude.yaml

Claude.
A maintainer Claude mention, or the `claude` label.
Skips a release issue and a Publish pull request. Those go to Publish PR.
Opens or continues `claude-issue-<number>-...`.
A later mention on that pull request continues the branch.
A later mention on the issue does not commit.
One writer at a time, shared with Codex Review (`claude-<number>`).

== codex-review.yaml

Codex Review.
Codex's summary on a Renovate pull request or a Claude issue pull request,
and a successful Dependency Review run.
Publish pull requests are not in this loop.
Claude fixes open findings for two rounds.
The third round is only reported.
A failed or unreadable review adds `help wanted`.

== codex-watchdog.yaml

Codex Review Watchdog.
Hourly, and on manual dispatch.
Flags a Renovate or Claude issue pull request whose head has had no Codex review for two hours,
and adds `help wanted` once per head.

== publish-pr.yaml

Publish PR.
The `claude` label on the release issue,
or a maintainer Claude mention on the Publish pull request.
Refuses when the tag already exists or the Publish pull request is already merged.
Continues an existing `publish-vX.Y.Z` branch.
Claude commits `Publish vX.Y.Z` with only the version, lockfile, changelog, READMEs, and roadmap.
Does not tag or publish.

== publish.yaml

Publish.
A `v*` tag push. npm trusted publishing is bound to this file name.
The tag must be signed and annotated, on `main` or `vX.Y.x`,
with a matching `package.json` version and a changelog section.
Then `lint:build`, `dist`, and `npm publish --provenance ./dist`.
Dist-tag `latest` on `main`, `backport-X.Y` on a backport branch, and `next` for a prerelease.
Does not create the GitHub Release.

== Renovate

`renovate.json` opens one pull request per dependency, with no automerge, and `rangeStrategy` `bump`.
Majors, peer updates, and TypeScript updates get `help wanted`.
`renovate-regenerate` recreates a branch.
There is no Dependabot config and no `CODEOWNERS`.
